- 15–40 min: focused walkthrough (inference runtime, routing, Dedicated vs Private)
- 40–55 min: breakout rooms (vertical/opportunity-specific)
- 55–60 min: wrap + next steps / mutual action items

- Option A: Wed Dec 8 — 5:00pm–6:00pm PST
- Option B: Thu Dec 9 — 6:30pm–7:30pm PST
